cards.title: Rubin changes the network bill
cards.question: Does rack-scale AI move more spending into optical links and switching?
cards.selfCheck: More rack traffic needs links; test ports and optics revenue.
cards.prompt: FACT Aug 2026: NVIDIA said Spectrum-6 with pluggable and co-packaged optics was arriving in AI factories. NEW PROOF Nov 17: NVIDIA says Vera Rubin NVL72 has shipped and announced Cisco USFP optical-module form factor for higher density and efficiency. HYPOTHESIS: growing rack and cluster bandwidth increases switch and optical dollars per installed accelerator. TEST: port shipments, optical attach, power/bit, production revenue; disconfirm copper/AEC persistence and lower network content. 7d Nov17 launch; 30d optics thesis COHR/MRVL; 90d Aug production roadmap. https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/ https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Second-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/default.aspx

cards.title: Cisco's AI mix is changing
cards.question: Can CSCO convert hyperscaler AI demand into durable high-margin sales?
cards.selfCheck: FY27 AI target $9B; test organic mix and margins.
cards.prompt: FACT Nov 12 Cisco raised FY27 hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenue expectation to $9B, more than twice FY26 total; Q1 FY27 company revenue $18.5B (+24% y/y). FACT Nov17 NVIDIA announced Cisco USFP optical-module work. HYPOTHESIS: Cisco captures more AI network economics than its legacy enterprise-networking identity implies; this is publicly disclosed, not undiscovered. TEST: quarterly hyperscaler revenue, order conversion, operating margin, organic vs acquired contribution. Counter: hyperscaler concentration, rival switching and margin dilution. https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m11/cisco-reports-first-quarter-earnings.html https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/

cards.title: The $9B promise has a clock
cards.question: What must Cisco deliver to make its FY27 AI forecast credible?
cards.selfCheck: Nov 12 target is guidance; verify quarterly AI shipments.
cards.prompt: ORIGINAL Nov 12 2026: Cisco projected $9B FY27 AI infrastructure revenue from hyperscalers, more than 2x FY26. NEW Nov17 NVIDIA announced Cisco collaboration on USFP optics; no proof yet of material USFP revenue. HYPOTHESIS: FY27 order conversion reveals a business mix shift. TEST: next Cisco quarterly AI sales, order backlog, margins and USFP qualifications. Distinguish FY27 forecast from booked and recognized sales; failure if mix or margins disappoint. https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m11/cisco-reports-first-quarter-earnings.html https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/

cards.title: A $9B target isn't a rerating
cards.question: Is Cisco's incremental AI growth profitable enough to change its earnings profile?
cards.selfCheck: Test AI growth against incremental operating profit.
cards.prompt: FACT Cisco Nov12 Q1 revenue $18.5B (+24%) and non-GAAP operating margin 37.8%; FY27 hyperscaler AI revenue expectation $9B. HYPOTHESIS: AI mix could raise revenue but compress margins; alternative operating leverage could surprise. Consensus EPS revisions and current valuation not independently verified: do not assert undervaluation. TEST next 2-6 months: segment/mix disclosures, gross and operating margin, cash conversion, forward EV/earnings vs verified estimates. https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m11/cisco-reports-first-quarter-earnings.html

cards.title: Watch Cisco; demand margin proof
cards.question: When does Cisco's AI-network growth become investable rather than a headline?
cards.selfCheck: WATCH: verify AI mix, margins, valuation; reject misses.
cards.prompt: Educational WATCH not buy instruction. 2-8 weeks: read Cisco Nov12 release and upcoming quarterly guidance; 2-6 months compare actual hyperscaler AI infrastructure revenue run-rate to $9B FY27 target. Compare price/forward earnings and estimates only from verified current data. Bull: profitable AI switching and optics attach. Bear: customer insourcing, white-box switching, weaker mix, margin erosion or delayed orders. Contrast with Nov16 MRVL and Nov17 COHR optical thesis; no fabricated target price. https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m11/cisco-reports-first-quarter-earnings.html https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/

cards.title: A design win is not a margin
cards.question: How do you detect a network inflection before it appears in EPS?
cards.selfCheck: Follow design → port shipment → revenue → profit.
cards.prompt: Teach investment evidence ladder using Cisco Nov12 FY27 $9B AI guidance and Nov17 NVIDIA USFP collaboration: dated claim, qualification, production, shipment, recognized revenue, incremental margin and cash. Distinguish roadmap from shipment and shipment from profitability. Compare MRVL and COHR theses from Nov16-17. Disconfirm with lost sockets, hyperscaler insourcing or lower switch margins. https://newsroom.cisco.com/c/r/newsroom/en/us/a/y2026/m11/cisco-reports-first-quarter-earnings.html https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Third-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/
